title: 序章7 救治女王序章8 马尔提雅的历史
content_zh:
门后的世界，并没有黎木想象的热火朝天。
似乎是某些印象先入为主了。
实际上，完全相反。
参与劳动的犯人，实在少的可怜，并且大部分做事都是兴致缺缺。
她们只是不想待在那个压抑的牢房里罢了。
当然，黎木也不会傻到就那么盯着别人看，还是早点前往狮女交代的地方好。
“医疗室，医疗室...”
黎木不认识字，只能透过房门观察里面的情况。
好在，一切都进行的比较顺利。
因为医疗室附近血腥味比较重，还有狱警把守，黎木很快便找到了。
递交完工作牌，狱警透过面罩瞥了眼黎木，便将他放进去了。
医疗室显得非常简陋。
整个地面，包括床铺，没有半点布料的踪影，只有干草，和牢房里一样。
也没有护士、医生的身影，就那么让异族搁里面躺着，颇有几分自生自灭的意思。
床铺一共两排，12张床。
病人却有近20位，所以伤势较轻的几人只能睡在地上。
黎木的到来，惊动了几名伤势不重的异族。
她们有些惊讶于雄性的出现，但却没有说什么，只是盯着黎木。
那种被一堆异常生命盯着的感觉，就像是在大白鲨嘴前潜游，窒息感几乎要从嘴里喷出来。
黎木强忍着心中的不适，四下观望。

终于，在里侧，发现了那道熟悉的身影。
此刻，她正静谧的躺在粗糙的床板上，宛如一件精美的艺术品，与周围的环境格格不入。
只不过，其体表的淤青与肿胀，哪怕搁着一段距离也能清楚看见。
黎木深呼吸一口气，缓步走到其跟前：“收到格莱尔的请求，我来给您治疗。”
缓缓睁开眼睛。
深邃的眸子微微眯着，没有说话。
但仅仅是那么看着，也让黎木感到颤抖。
“冒犯了，伟大的黄金狮子女王。”
黎木调整心态，声音平和而坦然。
得益于酒桌文化，既不显得过分谄媚，也不太过失礼。
随后，黎木开始检查起其伤势。
出奇的是，黎木一进入状态，朦胧间似有些许关于养生、敲背、洗脚、中医、工地急救的记忆涌现...
这边轻触，那边轻捏，竟也能说道一二。
“肋骨骨折，关节脱落，肌肉拉伤...”
黎木忍不住喃喃道，“接下来可能要与您高贵的身体有所接触，在此向您表达歉意。”
虽然无法完全救治，但皮肉骨的简单处理对黎木来说却并不难做。
content_en:
The world behind the door was not as lively as Li Mu imagined.
It seems that some impressions have been preconceived.
In fact, quite the opposite.
There are very few prisoners participating in labor, and most of the work is done without interest.
They just didn't want to stay in that oppressive cell.
Of course, Li Mu would not be stupid enough to just stare at others, so it would be better to go to the place where the lion girl told him early.
"Medical room, medical room..."
Li Mu didn't know how to read and could only observe the situation inside through the door.
Fortunately, everything went relatively smoothly.
Because the smell of blood was relatively strong near the medical room and there were prison guards guarding it, Li Mu found it quickly.
After handing over the work badge, the prison guard glanced at Li Mu through his mask and put him in.
The medical room looked very shabby.
There was no trace of fabric on the entire floor, including the bed, just hay, just like in the cell.
There were no nurses or doctors around, so the aliens were just left lying there, seemingly to fend for themselves.
There are two rows of beds, with 12 beds.
There were nearly 20 patients, so those with minor injuries could only sleep on the ground.
Li Mu's arrival alarmed several foreigners who were not seriously injured.
They were a little surprised by the male's appearance, but they didn't say anything and just stared at Li Mu.
The feeling of being stared at by a bunch of abnormal beings is like swimming in front of the mouth of a great white shark, with a suffocating feeling that almost spurts out of the mouth.
Li Mu suppressed the discomfort in his heart and looked around.
Finally, I found that familiar figure inside.
At this moment, she was lying quietly on the rough bed board, like a beautiful piece of art, incompatible with the surrounding environment.
However, the bruises and swelling on its body surface can be clearly seen even from a distance.
Li Mu took a deep breath and walked slowly to him: "After receiving Greer's request, I'm here to treat you."
Open your eyes slowly.
His deep eyes narrowed slightly and he said nothing.
But just looking at it made Li Mu feel trembling.
"Offended, the great Golden Lion Queen."
Li Mu adjusted his mentality and his voice was calm and calm.
Thanks to the wine table culture, it neither seems too flattering nor too rude.
Afterwards, Li Mu began to check his injuries.
Surprisingly, as soon as Li Mu entered the state, some hazy memories about health preservation, back tapping, foot washing, traditional Chinese medicine, and construction site first aid appeared...
A light touch here, a light pinch there, and you can actually say something.
"Broken ribs, broken joints, pulled muscles..."
Li Mu couldn't help but murmured, "I may have to come into contact with your noble body next, so I would like to express my apologies to you."
Although complete treatment was not possible, simple treatment of the skin, flesh and bones was not difficult for Li Mu.
